displayName: Ferni daily outreach sent nothing two days running

documentation.content: The daily outreach run (POST /api/outreach/scheduler/daily, 16:00Z) processed users but sent to none of them on two runs in a row. A zero like that read as healthy for five days in October 2026 (#1782). Read the run's `skipReasons` and `genericCheckInsBlocked` in the "Daily outreach job complete" log line. If the zero is intended (grounded check-ins on, nothing grounded to say), say so in the run report rather than silencing this. Needs the log metric `daily_outreach_zero_sends` (monitoring/promise/daily-outreach-zero-sends-metric.json). The 25 h rolling window holds two daily runs. Promise-ledger design, alert policy 4.

conditions.displayName: Two zero-send daily runs within 25 hours
